page_title: Spokenly: Free AI Dictation for Mac, iPhone, Windows & Linux

sources.entry: Spokenly - Voice-to-text with 100+ languages, offline mode, and AI-powered formatting.

summary.name: Spokenly
summary.one_liner: Spokenly is a dictation app that types your speech at the cursor in any application on Mac, Windows, Linux, and iPhone, using local Whisper/Parakeet models or cloud engines.
use_cases: dictating messages and emails in any app
talking to coding agents like Claude or Cursor
summary.what_it_does: Press a shortcut, speak, and text appears at the cursor in any app that accepts text input. It runs local Whisper and Parakeet models for free offline transcription, and supports cloud engines such as OpenAI, Deepgram and Groq through the user's own API keys. AI Instructions can fix grammar, remove filler words and format text for the target app. Streaming engines show words as you speak, and past dictations can be searched, replayed and exported. It can also record microphone and system audio on Mac for later transcription.
notable: Local-only mode blocks all network requests and keeps on-device model audio on the Mac
Supports 100+ languages with automatic language detection and mid-sentence language mixing
Free tier includes Whisper and Parakeet models with no account needed
Records meetings from microphone and system audio without a meeting bot
caveats: Cloud models require your own API keys on the Free and Local+ tiers; the Pro tier ($12/month or $144/year) includes high-accuracy cloud models and AI cleanup
Language quality varies by model and language
Notch/Capsule styles and settings sync are paid extras (Local+, $29 once)
